en: BukSU is composed of several colleges including the:
- College of Arts and Sciences
- College of Education
- College of Business
- College of Nursing
- College of Technologies
- College of Public Administration and Governance
- College of Law
ceb: Ang BukSU gilangkuban sa pipila ka mga kolehiyo lakip ang:
- College of Arts and Sciences
- College of Education
- College of Business
- College of Nursing
- College of Technologies

phrases: what are the colleges in buksu

en: The College of Arts and Sciences (CAS) offers a variety of courses that you can choose from. Here is the list of courses under CAS:
Bachelor of Science in Biology, Major in Biotechnology (BS-BIO)
Bachelor of Arts in Social Science (AB SocSci)
Bachelor of Arts in Philosophy (AB-PHILO)
Bachelor of Science in Environmental Science, Major in Environmental Heritage Studies (BS-ES)
Bachelor of Arts in Sociology (AB-SOCIO)
Bachelor of Arts in English Language (AB-ENG)
Bachelor of Science in Community Development (BS COMDEV)
Bachelor of Arts in Economics (AB-ECON)
Bachelor of Science in Development Communication (BSDC)
Bachelor of Science in Mathematics (BS-MATH)
For more information, you can visit the BukSU Admissions page, where you can find the complete list of courses offered:
https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph/courses
